title: Reservations and Move-In on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Reservation terms.** Reservations under the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement are free and hold one specific available unit at its posted street rate on the reservation date. A customer may cancel a reservation at any time before move-in at no charge.

**Hold period.** A move-in on a reservation may be completed only when the handling date is not later than the reservation date plus the class's reservation hold days. The hold counts calendar days starting the day after the reservation date and ends at the close of the last counted day. A lapsed reservation is cancelled by the system and the unit may be reserved again.

**At move-in.** The tenant presents the class's required identity document, signs the month-to-month agreement and chooses a coverage source, and the first period's rent, the class's administrative fee and any class security deposit are posted. A promotion or military discount is attached at reservation and applied at move-in under the rent-billing rule.

The hold is measured from the reservation date in the company's record of that reservation.

## Hold boundary (hypothetical 7-day hold, reservation made on 3 May)

| Move-in date | Day after reservation | Move-in may be completed |
|---|---|---|
| 3 May | same day | yes |
| 10 May | day 7, the last counted day | yes |
| 11 May | day 8 | no — the reservation has lapsed |

With a 14-day hold the last move-in day for the same reservation would be 17 May.

## Points of judgement

- A customer who reserved a unit at a posted street rate keeps that rate at move-in within the hold, because the reservation holds the unit at its street rate on the reservation date.
- Cancelling an unclaimed reservation costs the customer nothing.
